links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of chatbot patient-education responses versus recommended patient reading level
links.effect: Readability differed significantly across chatbots (FRE p=0.004; FKGL p<0.001); ChatGPT-5 required the highest reading level; most responses were above eighth-grade level.
links.quote: Most chatbot responses were above an eighth-grade reading level, which may challenge general patient comprehension.

screen.reason: The study evaluates and compares the performance (accuracy, readability, quality, actionability) of five generative LLM chatbots answering consumer dental health questions offline, without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
